summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine local-market bond placement. On April 23, 2026, it placed Series BJ dematerialized bearer bonds (ticker BSTDBJ0425) for Ch$23,000,000,000 due October 1, 2029, at an average rate of 5.69%, using an existing line of credit registered on April 30, 2025. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity is noted. This is an ordinary debt financing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
